text: This report includes a revised outline of the performance objectives of the Chief Executive Officer for 2022 as requested by the Board of Directors of CreateTO.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Approved the annual objectives for 2022 as outlined in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 2, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 2, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO remain confidential in its entirety, as it deals with personal matters about an identifiable individual.
